name: vpk-html
description: Renders supplied material into offline, single-file HTML: reports, one-pagers, briefs, memos, decks, changelogs, portfolios, resumes and engineering pages. Two-column story explainers are repo-only: their kit lives in the VPK repository under artifacts/vpk-html/eu26-animation-explained/ and imports VPK app code, so an installed copy outside that repository renders the templates only.
